research_question: Does the later Seki-related 《授時暦經立成》 provide an independent, author-autograph or direct original G893 solar-table precision witness, or only a downstream partially recomputed manuscript tradition?

evidence.author: Fujiwara Matsusaburo (藤原松三郎)
evidence.title: 〈和算史ノ研究 VII — 關孝和ノ著述〉
evidence.directly_viewed: original journal PDF pp201-202 (zero-based 0-1) and printed p206 (zero-based 5), via screenshots
findings: In 1940 Fujiwara examined six Seki-attributed manuscript titles at Ise Jingu Bunko. A colophon states the group was donated to Hayashizaki Bunko by Saito Nobuyoshi in Kansei 1 (1789); this dates the deposit, not the composition or copying of each book.
Saito's colophon asserts Seki's hand, but Fujiwara compared it with a separately attributed original autograph licence and explicitly withheld acceptance of the handwriting identity.
Fujiwara printed p206 reports a four-juan manuscript 《授時暦經立成》 internal Tenna 1 (1681) wording, with juan 1 太陽立成, 2 太陰立成, 3 半晝夜分, 4 五星立成.

Fujiwara specifically compares it to Ogawa Masai's Kanbun 13 (1673) 《大元授時暦經立成》 and reports broad agreement but some recalculated values; this defeats any presumption of copy-to-copy numerical identity without exact row collation.
evidence.limits: An investigator's 1941 printed testimony is not a presently verified 1681 physical autograph, G893 original exemplar, or independent precision glyph of the six unresolved historical controls.

evidence.provider: Tokyo Woman's Christian University (author-hosted scholarly paper)
evidence.author: Naoki Osada (長田直樹)
evidence.title: 〈関孝和編『開方飜変之法』の諸写本について〉
evidence.directly_viewed: PDF printed pp15-16, screenshot zero-based pp14-15
findings: Printed p15 quotes Saito's 1789 Jingu donation record and identifies the six donated manuscripts including 《授時暦經立成》 and 《授時暦經立成之法》.

The author explicitly rejects equating the six manuscripts' shared hand with Seki's autograph, and reconstructs a later transmission possibility from the Saito circle; this is scholarly inference, not authentication of the solar table's day-by-day readings.
The proposed teacher chain 寺内良弼→西塚重勝→葛谷實順→眞木明雅→齋藤信芳 is a scope-limited copy-line hypothesis, not a proven G893-to-Japan direct stemma.
evidence.limits: The article's detailed original collations focus on 《開方飜變之法》. Extend neither its exact manuscript parentage nor the chronology mechanically to a particular 《授時暦經立成》 folio.

evidence.title: 2026a proceedings, section 3-2 ‘立成’ to ‘表’
evidence.directly_viewed: Web text of proceedings printed pp38-39; screenshot of the large PDF was unavailable due fetch-size limit
findings: Identifies Tohoku University Library copy 《授時暦経立成》 with call mark 7/31645/1 and describes an illustrated frame 3 left leaf headed 太陽立成.

Attributes the manuscript hand to 淡山尚綱 (1686-1749) while using Seki's authorship as a work-level description; this requires direct first-party physical catalog and individual scanned folio verification.
evidence.limits: The Tohoku exact item record, original scan bytes, page dimensions, printed numerical row and original-copy date were not obtained in this batch. This remains a locator not a numeric target image.

chronology_firewall.source_original_g893: Early SNU 奎貴893 remains a separate physical/source system, not shown to have copied or been copied by the Japanese witnesses.
chronology_firewall.japanese_1673_print: Ogawa's printed 1673 table is a later comparator, not evidence that the 1681-labelled manuscript reproduces all numeric values.
chronology_firewall.year_1681: The dated wording in a manuscript and the scholarly estimated compilation time are distinct from the surviving item's transcription date.
chronology_firewall.year_1789: Proven deposit year, not proof of the surviving book's author autograph or all copied folios' dates.
chronology_firewall.japanese_1711: Kamegai's 1711 published explanatory work identified in 13RY is separate from Seki-associated 1681 and Ogawa 1673 witnesses.
chronology_firewall.genealogy: No direct descent, direct copy or independent stemma vote without authenticated source-target page and shared distinctive readings.

adjudication.positive: New source-specific Japanese mathematical-table manuscript family locator with a historically documented manuscript-autograph caution; contrasts a claimed 1681 work-level date, a 1673 published comparator and a 1789 donation without collapsing physical-copy identity.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Seki autograph claim for Jingu manuscript group is not admissible; inscription attributed to Saito is an attribution claim contradicted by scholarly handwriting studies.
No 1673 Ogawa → 1681 Seki manuscript direct copying edge, nor 1681 Seki → G893 reverse chronological relation, nor parent manuscript of the extant 1789-donated group proven.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Fetch exact first-party Tohoku catalog and original image for call mark 7/31645/1 to inspect any relevant first-hand same-column solar-table digits; use only if target field exists.
Independently obtain G893 source-original same-field 少/微 radix, carry or fifth/sixth digits before attempting one of the six numeric historical finales.
